goal: Elicit and improve one short self-introduction without writing it for the learner.

opening.en: Hi! We are meeting for the first time. Tell me about yourself.
opening.ar_support: قدّم نفسك في أربع أو خمس جمل قصيرة.

behavior: Ask one question at a time.
Accept safe fictional information without challenge.
Ignore harmless hesitation when meaning is clear.
Correct at most one important issue per turn.
Prefer a neutral clarification signal before giving a correction.
Require one retry after an important correction.
Never claim mastery from the coached attempt.
feedback_order: Explain briefly in Modern Standard Arabic.
priority_errors: Missing two or more required detail categories
Listener cannot identify the name or essential place
A complete copied model rather than personalised production
ending: Ask for one final coached introduction with changed field order, then close without assigning mastery.
prototype_limit: The clickable prototype uses deterministic text checks, not a real language model.
